conventions.stored_frame: ODOL stored frame (auto-centred: MLOD vertices minus bounding_center). World position of a placed object = this frame's origin (as used by the straight-lattice check).
conventions.axes: x = right, y = up, z = model forward. Model +Z points UPSTREAM; 'entry' = downstream (-Z) plate end, 'exit' = upstream (+Z) plate end; turn and headings are for travel upstream.
conventions.heading: compass: degrees from +Z towards +X (world: from north towards east). Lattice classes mod 180: 0 = N-S, 90 = E-W, 135 = NW-SE (the triangulation diagonal, lines x+z = k*7.5, spacing 5.303 m), 45 = NE-SW (vertex lines x-z = k*7.5, not triangulation edges).
conventions.lateral: positive = right of upstream travel (= +X for an unrotated straight)
conventions.flow_naming: curve_left turns LEFT when following the flow downstream (it turns +44.4 deg = right when travelling upstream); curve_right the opposite.
conventions.water_proxy_frame: proxy child vertices are placed with the child's MLOD origin at the proxy point: parent_stored = child_stored + proxy_position + child_bounding_center (INFERRED convention; supported by the exact xz match of water and roadway outlines for every kind, incl. curves whose child bounding centre is offset 3.6/1.4 m)

roadway_faces.layout: one strip of quads: water_ext = flat central run; concrete_ext = 3 skirt quads per end dropping to the plate end (no faces outside the plate)

water_proxy.in_visual_lods: 0-4 (every visual LOD incl. LOD 4, which contains only the proxy triangle)
water_proxy.outline: LOD0 = the roadway strip outline (same xz to <1 mm) raised by the offset, i.e. it covers the whole plate width incl. the end lips; LOD1 = flat run plus the first lip rung only

next_upstream_piece.frame: neighbour origin (m) in this piece's EXIT frame: origin = this piece's upstream plate-end centre, along = channel heading at exit, lateral = right of upstream travel; kink = neighbour entry heading - this exit heading

previous_downstream_piece.frame: neighbour origin (m) in this piece's ENTRY frame: origin = this piece's downstream plate-end centre, along = channel heading at entry (upstream travel), lateral = right; kink = this entry heading - neighbour exit heading

joint_definitions.kink: channel heading of next piece at its downstream end minus channel heading of this piece at its upstream end (upstream travel); curves: exit = model heading + turn
joint_definitions.exit_port_frame: origin at this piece's upstream plate-end centre, along = channel heading at exit, lat = right of upstream travel

network.link_method: mutual-nearest: upstream sill centroid of piece i to downstream sill centroid of piece j, < 6 m

vertical_continuity.note: water top = flat_top_y of the water proxy LOD0 (inferred +0.25/+0.20/+0.18 above roadway) transformed with the placement matrix; step = next (upstream) minus this; terrain from Terrain('chernarus').y

digest.long_curve_left: Plate 14 m wide, 16 rungs. Entry (downstream) end centre stored (-3.553, -13.44) heading 0; exit end centre (5.552, 8.546) heading +44.36 (upstream travel; flow-wise a LEFT turn). Entry->exit: along 21.99, lateral +9.10 (entry frame). Lead-in straight 6.98 m, arc R~16.2 m, lead-out 3.07 m (skirt). PI at stored (-3.553, -0.763) = MLOD (0, 0.68). Chernarus: model Z only at 90 or 135 mod 180; joins 90->135 or 135->0; scale p50 0.90.
digest.long_curve_right: Mirror of curve_left: entry end (3.731, -13.643) heading 0; exit (-5.74, 8.734) heading -44.53. Along 22.38, lateral -9.47. Lead-in 6.98 m, arc R~17.0 m, lead-out 3.0 m. PI stored (3.731, -0.895) = MLOD (0, 0.75). Chernarus: model Z only at 0 or 135 mod 180; joins 0->135 or 135->90; scale p50 0.85.
digest.short_slanted: 6.7 x 11.9 m hexagonal plate with mitred ends (rung lines 37-58 deg in the model frame). Channel runs along model Z (sills at (0.42,-3.44) and (-0.58,3.64), 7.1 m apart). Roadway flat y -0.158, water +0.20 above. Chernarus: always E-W (model Z 90/270), origins on a vertex line laterally and at mid-cell along; pitch 7.5 m; 90-deg elbow = slanted + slanted_inv.
digest.short_slanted_inv: Mirror of slanted: rung lines 123-147 deg; sills (0.02,-3.8) and (0.66,3.6). Roadway y 0.087, water +0.20. Chernarus: always N-S (model Z 0/180), on vertex lines at mid-cell; elbows with slanted.
digest.long_snake: Plate and roadway identical to long_straight (14 x 24 m). Bed meanders up to ~2 m off axis and its end sills sit ~1.0-1.1 m to -X of the straight's. Chernarus: all 29 at 45 mod 180 (NE-SW), off vertex lines, joined to lattice straights with ~45-deg kinks.
digest.short_arrow: 6 m wide straight with pointed ends (z -5.53..5.59), flat water z -2.48..2.54, roadway y 0.239, water +0.182 above. 14 in Chernarus, any heading, used at elbows/kinks as a filler.

measured: all model-frame numbers (ODOL stored frame) from the leaf models: plate rungs from the roadway LOD (res 3e15), bed bands from LOD0 named selections, sills from the geometry LOD (res 1e13), memory LOD (1e15) points
water proxy model, transform (identity orientation, position = -bounding_center of the parent) and vertices of both proxy LODs
Chernarus placements: 1682 pieces, scale, headings, pitch, 1642 mutual-nearest sill links, joint kinks, lattice offsets (step 7.5, x+z diagonal)
inferred: proxy placement convention (child MLOD origin at the proxy point) that yields water = roadway outline + 0.25 m (0.20 slanted, 0.18 arrow flat); the alternative convention would misplace curve water by 3.8 m in xz, so it is ruled out by geometry but not by an engine test
channel axis of slanted pieces = model Z (from Chernarus usage, not from the mesh)
the reasons behind patterns (mitres on the triangulation diagonal; elbows only make NE/SW-type corners) are readings of the measured counts
moss/sand families assumed geometrically identical to leaf (only leaf parsed)
not_verified: visible water in the client; how the engine renders the 45-deg kinked joints; whether _2 variants behave the same in placement (none placed in Chernarus)
